comparison.primary: last comparable normalized purchase cost before the receipt movement
comparison.secondary: weighted average inventory cost immediately before the receipt movement
comparison.different_purchase_units: compare only after normalization to base unit
comparison.missing_cost: no price event until actual receipt cost is completed

history_semantics: immutable snapshot including item/category labels, supplier and unit context; later master-data changes do not rewrite prior events

notification.thresholds: manager-configurable; no threshold number is seeded or active until explicitly saved
notification.route_resolution: canonical Local Staff route is converted to the Public Staff counterpart by SoknaStaffRuntime.staffPath()
